title: A solo session with no parent and no cs-build tag may take the batch-runner hat for its own merge
why:
The merge role file has no form for a solo session that the owner started (follow-up of step merge-role-allow). Owner question 00:17 CST Nov 15 (relayed by the consultant 00:24 CST): "did our conversation on roles as hats land? to main is that how things wokr now?". Answer, 00:18 CST (REST reads at main 20963a214992 unless marked relayed). The ruling is on main: docs/decisions/session-tiers.md, bullet "Roles are hats" (owner, 2026-11-10 14:33 CST, "yes hats model works"; one-lane chat rule added in commit eac750146, 2026-11-11 20:11 UTC). Meaning: a session role is a set of jobs and a session may wear several; in a one-lane run that lane holds every role it needs (writes its own page items as triage, merges its own PR as batch runner); how many sessions share the roles depends on the size of the run, never on local versus cloud. It is a decision record on main; the loaded CLAUDE.md carries the collapse to coordinator or lane (session roles) but not the hats wording (read from this session's loaded CLAUDE.md). The merge-side part is NOT on main: PR #2701 (solo session wears the batch-runner hat for its own merge) is open, draft, head 35df574ffd55, mergeable_state dirty, base fccff95e (old), 17 commits, last updated 2026-11-13 18:01 UTC (12:01 CST Nov 13); the coordinator asked to rebase it 00:24 CST Nov 15 (relayed). So today the hats model is the ruling and governs the roles' jobs, but a solo session still cannot wear the batch-runner hat at the merge guard until #2701 merges. Not read: #2701's diff; whether other guards read hats.

Related: item 858. The coordinator's 01:04 pick (option A fix verifier, then re-post with --fix-check) is the earlier step; this is the next refusal after it. The denial stands until the owner lifts it.
